lb_dynamics.x138_era_jumps: 11 of 53 band teams were seen at <= 0.954 (x138 copy level) in round notes of 25-26 Sep before reaching 0.960-0.966: Takahiro Katsumata 0.953->0.963->0.966, Syed Asad Ali 0.953->0.965 (18 subs), Biomed Foresight 0.954->0.964, cheng ren01 0.952->0.962, Jeff Horon 0.948->0.961->0.963, RicardoLopez 0.948->0.961, Abnormal Guys 0.947->0.961 (private kernel named x138-s3forks), Brothers 0.953->0.957->0.960, kusui26 0.953->0.957->0.960 (11 subs), mmtyeu 0.951->0.960, Bio-Pirates 0.950->0.960.
lb_dynamics.interpretation: x138 (public 21 Sep) is the common base for a large part of the band; the extra +0.007..+0.013 came within 1-3 days and few subs for several teams (kusui26 11, Syed 18-23, Quantizr 11, Ascent 14, Jivansh 14). That fits bringing an existing own component (retrained detector/secondary, own division or placement model) onto x138 better than single-knob LB tuning (Justin CH123's 10 knob changes all lost; our own knob probes gave about +0.001). Only one team's method is documented (Abnormal Guys: x138 + ends/forks).
